Tags Input

Tags Input allows users to add and remove multiple values as tag chips. Supports autocomplete suggestions, max count limits, validation, color variants, and custom delimiters.

Basic Tags Input

Type text and press Enter or comma to add a tag. Click the × to remove.

HTML
<div class="zak-tags-input" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--zak-border); border-radius: var(--zak-radius-md); min-height: 2.5rem; cursor: text;" onclick="this.querySelector('input').focus()">
  <input type="text" class="zak-tags-input-field" placeholder="Add tags..." style="border: none; outline: none; flex: 1; min-width: 80px; box-shadow: none;">
</div>

With Autocomplete Suggestions

Show suggestions while typing to help users pick existing tags.

Max Count

Limit the number of tags a user can add.

Maximum 3 tags allowed

Show error states for invalid tags.

With Delimiter

Accept tags separated by commas, semicolons, or other delimiters.

Separate tags with commas or press Enter

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
function initTagsInput(containerId, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  var input = container.querySelector('.zak-tags-input-field');
  var tags = [];

  function renderTags() {
    container.querySelectorAll('.zak-badge').forEach(function (b) { b.remove(); });
    tags.forEach(function (tag, i) {
      var badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'zak-badge' + (opts.color ? ' zak-badge-' + opts.color : '');
      badge.innerHTML = tag + ' <button style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;margin-left:4px;font-size:1rem;line-height:1;color:inherit;">&times;</button>';
      badge.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', function () {
        tags.splice(i, 1);
        renderTags();
      });
      container.insertBefore(badge, input);
    });
  }

  input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ',') && input.value.trim()) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var val = input.value.trim().replace(/,/g, '');
      if (opts.max && tags.length >= opts.max) return;
      if (opts.validate && !opts.validate(val)) {
        var err = document.getElementById(containerId + '-error');
        if (err) err.textContent = 'Invalid: ' + val;
        return;
      }
      if (tags.indexOf(val) === -1) { tags.push(val); renderTags(); }
      input.value = '';
    }
    if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !input.value && tags.length) {
      tags.pop();
      renderTags();
    }
  });
}

initTagsInput('tags-basic');
initTagsInput('tags-max', { max: 3 });
initTagsInput('tags-validate', { validate: function (v) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); } });
initTagsInput('tags-delimiter', { color: 'primary' });

// Autocomplete suggestions
(function () {
  var skills = ['HTML','CSS','JavaScript','TypeScript','React','Vue','Angular','Node.js','Python','SQL','Docker'];
  var container = document.getElementById('tags-suggest');
  var input = document.getElementById('tags-suggest-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('tags-suggest-dropdown');
  var tags = [];

  function renderSuggestTags() {
    container.querySelectorAll('.zak-badge').forEach(function (b) { b.remove(); });
    tags.forEach(function (tag, i) {
      var badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'zak-badge zak-badge-primary';
      badge.innerHTML = tag + ' <button style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;margin-left:4px;font-size:1rem;line-height:1;color:inherit;">&times;</button>';
      badge.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', function () { tags.splice(i, 1); renderSuggestTags(); });
      container.insertBefore(badge, input);
    });
  }

  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    var q = input.value.toLowerCase();
    if (!q) { dropdown.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    var filtered = skills.filter(function (s) { return s.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 && tags.indexOf(s) === -1; });
    dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map(function (s) {
      return '<div style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--zak-bg-hover)\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'\'">' + s + '</div>';
    }).join('') : '<div style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;color:var(--zak-text-muted);font-size:0.875rem;">No suggestions</div>';
    dropdown.style.display = 'block';
    dropdown.querySelectorAll('div').forEach(function (item) {
      item.addEventListener('click', function () {
        tags.push(item.textContent);
        renderSuggestTags();
        input.value = '';
        dropdown.style.display = 'none';
      });
    });
  });

  input.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if ((e.key === 'Enter') && input.value.trim()) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var val = input.value.trim();
      if (tags.indexOf(val) === -1) { tags.push(val); renderSuggestTags(); }
      input.value = '';
      dropdown.style.display = 'none';
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#tags-suggest')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();
